manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: Twenty pilots fight through an arcade race with a light touch of battle royale. Dodge the traps and your rivals, and choose between speed and safety.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Vingt pilotes s'affrontent dans une course arcade au parfum de Battle Royale. Esquive pièges et rivaux. Choisis entre vitesse ou sécurité.

manifest.json:description.text: Twenty pilots launch onto a bending neon highway and five of them reach the flag. You start last. Hold the left or right of the screen to lean, and climb the board by physically overtaking the craft ahead — mines, barriers and the pilots you clip all come off a shield that nothing else refills. Every so often the tarmac forks, and the two things you need are never on the same branch: charge on the slow line, boosters and mines on the fast one. A line across the tarmac marks each cut, green while you are inside the rank it asks for and red while you are not; cross one and the field is really trimmed — 15 pilots left, then 10, then 5 — until the chequered arch at 1020m.

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: A magic bubble shooter where you must outpace the evil gnawing at the bubbles. Be quick, and outsmart the blight.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Un Bubble Shooter magique dans lequel il faut être plus rapide que le mal qui ronge les bulles. Il faudra donc être rapide et plus malin que la contamination.

manifest.json:description.text: Drag to aim, release to fire and match 3 bubbles to pop them — a cluster goes off one bubble at a time, each scoring on its own. Swap the loaded bubble for the next one whenever you like. Rainbows are jokers: one in the wall takes the colour of whatever lands on it, one fired into the rot gives a pocket of blighted bubbles their colour back — and those bubbles stay on the board. There is no clock: the blight winds up until the whole wall has turned, so the round is a race against it, and a cut-off bubble bursting on the floor pays a bonus on the way out.

manifest.json:description.text: Tap the instant a closing ring hits the bouncing ball — every ring lands on a beat of the track, but some beats are empty. Chain perfect taps for a huge combo, then survive the spiked sudden-death ring. On the web the climb crosses five worlds, each with its own rings and its own rule: rewind rings that throw the others back, sticky rings that hold the ball, dark rings that must not be tapped, mixed rings whose dark parts the ball slips through untapped — and all four at once in the last.

manifest.json:copy.en.tagline.text: Just two seconds to memorise the maze. Find your way back by the echo of your pulses.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Seulement deux secondes pour mémoriser le labyrinthe. Retrouve ton chemin grâce à l'écho des balles.

manifest.json:description.text: An electric labyrinth is powered up for two seconds — the only look you ever get at it. Then everything goes out: the maze, the six mouths along its floor, even the walls of the arena. Fire pulses up into a mouth and the board exists only where one just hit it, arcing white and dying out over a couple of seconds, so you are echolocating a maze you can no longer see. Each mouth is a one-way flap — a pulse pushes through and it drops shut behind — and of the six, one leads to the gate at the top and five are dead ends.

manifest.json:copy.fr.tagline.text: Aligne trois billes de même couleur. Trouve le coup qui déclenchera des explosions en chaîne !

manifest.json:description.text: Three plates turn on one hub — teeth on the outer one — each carrying twelve coloured beads in its housings, over the twelve rays drawn between the hub and the rim. Drag a plate and it turns alone; the other two hold. Rays that would pay light up under the beads while you turn, so a plate is never moved blind, and the dial only cashes them once it comes to rest. A paid ray is re-fed from outside the rim, and the beads that fly in can land on a ray of their own, so one move can keep paying long after you let go. Every four rays the hub's meter buys a special bead, and a move that pays two rays at once — or a chain at x8 — buys a bigger one. There are eight of them and no level ever carries the whole catalogue: a Charge unzips the plate it sits on, a Nova is wild and takes its colour off the entire dial, a Bomb clears the board outright, a Fire takes the two rays either side, a Laser fires through the hub and out the far side, a Score bead arms an x2, x5 or x10 window, a Slow bead holds the eclipse back — and an Ice bead, the one you do not want, freezes the plate it breaks on. The thirty levels introduce them one at a time and run in five worlds, each with its own material for the beads and its own palette for the machine.
